text:
sarah_pm: quick thread — trying to lock shape for 2.7 pricing: tiers + add-on caps. need fast alignment before roadmap sync tomorrow.
kevin_sales: customer asks are trending toward predictable burst allowances and per-customer reserved lanes. big accounts want explicit contract caps, not fuzzy "fair use".
maya_eng: from runtime side we can support short bursts via pre-warm + autoscale but sustained bursts need dedicated capacity. cost delta is ~3x sustained.
dina_finance: priority is revenue predictability. propose two controls: 1) monthly hard cap per add-on, 2) optional overage pricing at premium rate.
ali_legal: if we expose hard caps in contracts we need clear overage billing language + rollover rules. also data residency clauses for private deployments.
kevin_sales: sample ask: "Enterprise A" wants 5x baseline burst for 48 hours once per quarter, and ability to opt into a temporary reserved pool. will we support that as an add-on?
sarah_pm: we should list launch criteria: - SLA for reserved pool (p99 latency target) - telemetry + quota dashboards - billing events + invoice line items - legal clause templates available
jonah_prodops: ops question — capacity gating: if we let customers burst into shared pool, we need priority lanes and throttling policies to avoid noisy neighbor. default fallback should be lower-tier model, not hard failure.
maya_eng: implementation notes: continuous batching + KV cache means short bursts are cheap if request patterns repeat. sustained distinct sequences cost more. can we gate by token-weighted window? e.g., burst allowance measured as tokens per 6h.
dina_finance: token-window is fine, but keep UI simple. customers want "Burst credits: 100M tokens / quarter" style.
kevin_sales: +1 for credits. Sales prefers a productized "Burst Credits" add-on with SKUs: small/medium/large.
ali_legal: also need to avoid soft-promises. SKU should have exact quotas and clear renewal/expiry language.
sarah_pm: draft SKU names: "Burst Credits — Starter / Growth / Enterprise". caps map to token buckets: 50M / 250M / 1B. pricing TBD.
jonah_prodops: ops_bot: @ops_bot can you post current utilization metrics for shared pool?
ops_bot: snapshot uploaded: https://internal.redwood/ops/shared-pool-snapshot-1767778888 (shows median 60% utilization, 95th 87% during spikes) :chart_with_upwards_trend:
maya_eng: given those numbers, we can allow medium bursts for most customers but enterprise-level bursts should require dedicated capacity purchase or explicit reservation.
dina_finance: revenue model options: 1) prepaid credits (best for cash), 2) pay-as-you-go overage at 1.8x list, 3) reserved short-term pool for a premium. recommend prepaid + reserved.
kevin_sales: for large deals sales wants flexible one-off waivers for onboarding only. can we support time-limited credit grants?
sarah_pm: yes, but need guardrails: one-off grants should be limited to <30 days and require finance approval.
ali_legal: add conversion clause: unused credits expire, and waived credits must be appended to contract with approval chain.
jonah_prodops: ops action: define throttling policy prototype: token-window enforcement, fallback model mapping, and alerting for crossing 80% pool utilization.
maya_eng: eng action: estimate engineering effort for admin UI + quota enforcement + billing hooks. I can prep rough story points by EOD.
dina_finance: finance action: propose price per 50M burst-credit block and revenue recognition implications.
kevin_sales: sales action: collect top 5 deals with burst requirements and share concrete asks by EOD.
sarah_pm: decision for roadmap meeting: include "Burst Credits" as Beta add-on gated by: eng estimate, finance price, legal contract text. If any missing, push to quarter after.
kevin_sales: ack.
maya_eng: ack, will send effort estimate.
ali_legal: will draft contract appendix template.
dina_finance: will propose pricing bands.
jonah_prodops: will sketch throttling/alerting doc.
sarah_pm: thanks everyone. follow-ups in product sync 11:00am tomorrow. :calendar:
